name: SyncTogether - Watch Party
subtitle: Long-Distance Movie Night
description:
Movie night, even when you're apart. SyncTogether plays the same video at the same moment for everyone in the room, so you can watch together, hear each other and react together.

Made for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, Apple's foldable iPhone: the layout adapts to its large inner display and the fold. Also on Mac and Windows, with one account everywhere.

KEY FEATURES

• WATCH THE SAME THING
Play, pause and seek together and everyone stays in lockstep, with automatic drift correction and a readiness gate that waits until everyone is ready. Late joiners are brought straight to the right spot.
- YouTube: paste a public link and start watching together.
- Your own videos: pick an MP4, MKV, MOV or WebM from the Files app. SyncTogether checks that everyone has the same file, and signed-in hosts can optionally stream their file to members who do not have a copy.

• SEE AND HEAR EACH OTHER
Voice and video facecams sit right beside the video. Room chat has typing indicators, and quick animated emoji reactions float across the screen.

• YOUR OWN PLACE, FOR COUPLES AND LONG-DISTANCE
Pair two accounts and get Our Room, a free private room that's always yours. Plan date nights across time zones with a reminder before they start, build a weekly streak, keep your history, count down to your reunion and share a year card. Pairing is free for any two signed-in accounts.

• ROOMS IN SECONDS
Create a private room, then share a 6-character code or an invite link. Friends can join as guests, with no setup. Members can report and block anyone who misbehaves.

• PRIVACY-FIRST
No ads, and your personal data is never sold. Join as a guest with one tap, or sign in with Apple, Google or an email code. You can delete your account from your profile at any time.

Free to start: guests can host a room of up to 4 for 60 minutes, and a free account gets up to 8 people and 4-hour sessions with voice chat.

SYNCTOGETHER PATRON (OPTIONAL)
Patron is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly, that unlocks up to 16 watchers per room, up to 20 active rooms, persistent rooms, video facecams, watch sessions up to 24 hours and extended animated reactions. If either partner in a pair is a Patron, you both can plan date nights and see your full history. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use: https://synctogether.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://synctogether.app/privacy
